items.title: MECH-236 hippocampal z_goal-injection channel ablation (first behavioural test)
items.note: IGW-20260811-231 inline retry (original auto-session reaped NO_OP with no landing evidence). This SCRIPT ALREADY EXISTED, untracked, in the shared ree-v3 checkout -- clearly substantial legitimate work product from that original session, orphaned by the NO_OP outcome rather than lost. Found it while queuing an independently-authored alternative (also ON/OFF-ablation-shaped, teleport-based navigation design) for the same claim; read both in full and adopted THIS one instead of my own, since it is more mature: probe-calibrated PROXIMITY_GAP_FLOOR (from a documented Step 2.5a manual probe, not a guess), a natural 3-arm NOGOAL/CLOSED/OPEN design using real env.reset()-driven foraging rather than a synthetic teleport, an explicit P1 (ghost branch live) / P2 (z_goal formed comparably in CLOSED and OPEN) precondition gate so a null C_MAIN reads as evidence rather than an uninterpretable instrumentation gap, and it independently caught the E3-tick-cadence latched-diagnostics hazard (Step 3.5 Sample-size integrity) that this reviewing session had not needed to handle in its own design. My own alternative script was deleted rather than also queued, to avoid duplicate compute testing the identical claim two ways in one pass -- a single well-designed first evidence run is the right scope here; a second design is a legitimate follow-up ONLY if this one comes back ambiguous. GOV-REUSE-1 (per the script's own docstring): genuine_exp_count=0 for MECH-236 (claim_evidence.v1.json, 2026-08-09 lit-only), and no existing MECH-292/293 manifest (V3-EXQ-496/497/868/881) records a navigation/goal-terrain readout -- checked, not recoverable. Substrate readiness (2.5/2.5a): confirmed by direct source read (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py propose_trajectories, ree_core/agent.py _e3_tick) that use_mech293_ghost_probes is the ONLY code path through which current_z_goal reaches hippocampal trajectory proposals on this substrate; MECH-292/293 IMPLEMENTED 2026-04-27 per ree-v3/CLAUDE.md. No re-derive brake applies (MECH-236 has zero prior autopsies). DV-SYMMETRY (mandatory declaration, per the script's own docstring): contact/proximity readouts are count/magnitude-based over discrete env resource-contact and field-proximity events, not a CEM-internal rollout score; use_mech293_ghost_probes changes WHICH candidate CEM/E3 select (a discrete selection-path change), so broadcast-additive-constant invariance does not apply; the DV is a magnitude not an ordinal comparison, so monotone-rescaling invariance does not apply; per-seed rate aggregation via a pre-registered majority seed-fraction guards against a single-seed-layout permutation risk. Verified (this session): validate_experiments.py --strict OK (0 warnings across every checker, incl. arm-fingerprint); --dry-run smoke PASS (1 seed x 3 arms, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.933, goal_state_present=True, no writer defect) -- P1 (ghost branch live) correctly reads False at dry-run's 16-tick scale (ANCHOR_EVERY=8 needs >=2 writes in the SAME (scale,stream_mixture) family for the SD-039 dual-trace demotion the ghost bank ranks over; the full run's 400 ticks/cell give ~50 writes, ample) -- this is the documented, expected dry-run-scale reading per the script's own P1 precondition design, not a defect.
